A.action: Fourteenth symmetric graph fixture with Burnside contributions labelled by stabilizer action.
A.acceptance: Enumerate all states; direct/Burnside quotient equality, action-label invariance and deterministic hashes pass; scaling remains null.

B.action: Typed canonicalization across nested arrays and decimal boundary exponents.
B.acceptance: Equivalent values bind; tag, normalized-key, depth, token, precision and exponent-boundary controls reject; provider evidence null.

C.action: Eight concurrent readers, four replacement stages and executed local temp-file/directory fsync calls.
C.acceptance: Only complete declared payloads/descriptors and successful syscall results bind; crash/power-loss durability remains null.

D.action: Bind EOCD comment length/bytes, descriptor CRC and classic/ZIP64 offset arithmetic.
D.acceptance: Comment, CRC, count, disk, offset, size and extra-field mutations reject before payload access; real-producer corpus open.

E.action: Fourteenth synthetic issuer with threshold-policy history and receipt-policy binding.
E.acceptance: Policy version, quorum, signer set, freshness, head, scope, ancestry and time controls fail closed; physical sample null.

F.action: Eighteen-component sparse-block covariance model with explicit permutation equivalence.
F.acceptance: Exact permuted-model equivalence; invalid, missing, non-finite and zero outputs remain null; model only.

G.action: Compose five signed transforms and bind identity/inverse group-table rows.
G.acceptance: Exact closure, inverse, associativity, typed axes and covariance invariants pass; calibration null.

H.action: Eighteenth scenario with exhaustive leave-one through leave-ten subset intervals.
H.acceptance: Exact grid counts/range only; no distribution, probability or capital claim.

FND/EQN.action: Compose eleven affine maps and bind exact first and zero second derivative intervals.
FND/EQN.acceptance: Endpoint, derivative and inverse equality; source/order/dimension/nonmonotone mutations reject; no new-law claim.

SCM.action: Seven observers with quorum-five intersection certificates in the fiction-only transcript.
SCM.acceptance: Split, stale, fork, replay, downgrade, audience, revocation and membership controls reject; empirical coupling null.

AI-COST.action: Manifest v24 with compressed proofs over a non-power-of-two leaf set and domain-separated padding.
AI-COST.acceptance: Root, padding, minimality, order, index, source, schema, config and metric mutations reject; equivalence null.

QOS/QSVT.action: Compose twelve inverse pairs and distinguish sequential depth from a declared parallel lower bound.
QOS/QSVT.acceptance: Exact reconstruction, proof, tree, order and resource mutations with explicit bounds pass; hardware evidence null.

assumptions: All inputs are bounded fixtures or models.
Successful fsync calls are local syscall evidence and do not establish crash or power-loss durability.
Custody receipt hashes are synthetic fixtures, not cryptographic signatures.
SCM records are fiction-only and cannot satisfy an empirical evidence gate.
uncertainty: Provider authorization/billing, crash durability, archive interoperability, operational custody, measured covariance/calibration, owner priorities, independent derivation, real held-out equivalence and target hardware evidence remain open.
nonclaims: No measured QPU/GPU performance, scaling or quantum advantage.
No provider execution/invoice, commercial economics or capital result.
No crash durability, cryptographic signature, calibration, physical sample, new physical law, AI equivalence or empirical SCM result.
